Notice is hereby given that the First Annual General Meeting ("First AGM") of the Shareholders of
Downtown Rise Developments (Private) Limited will be held on 2 MAY 2025 at the Company's

registered office located at Third Floor, Pearl One, 94-B/1, MM Alam, Gulberg III, Lahore, to conduct

the following business:

1.

To confirm the minutes of the last general meeting of the shareholders of the company.

2.

To elect the Directors of the Company. The Board of Directors in their meeting on 21 April 2025,
has fixed the number of directors to be elected as four (4), in place of the following four retiring
director:

(Nominee Director of ZI Universal (Private) Limited)
b) Haseeb Moazam Malik (Nominee Director of ZI Universal (Private) Limited)

a) Zeeshan Ali Khan

(Nominee Director of Zameen Centre (SMC-Private) Limited)
c) Adil Ahmad Kamal
d) Mariam Saleem Akbar (Nominee Director of ZI Universal (Private) Limited)
3.

To receive, consider, and adopt the audited accounts of the Company for the period ended 30 June
2022 and 30 June 2023 together with the Financial Statements, Directors' Report, and Auditors'

Report thereon.

4.

To appoint Auditors of the Company till the next Annual General Meeting of the Company and fix

their remuneration.

5.

To discuss any other business with the permission of the Chairman

By the Order of the Board

NOTES:
a) A member entitled to attend and vote at the meeting is entitled to appoint a proxy to attend and
vote instead of himself/herself and the proxy need not be a member. Proxy in order to be
effective must be received by the Company at its registered office, not less than 48 hours before
the commencement of meeting.

b)

None of the directors have any interest in the said resolutions except as shareholders.

c)

As provided in the provisions of the Companies Act, 2017, notice of candidature for the office

of the Directors must be received in writing at least 14 days before the meeting of the registered
office of the Company.

d) Shareholders are required to immediately notify the Company of any changes to their postal
addresses.
